说明: 严格微调对比看基础模型与 LoRA；API 教师仅作能力上限参考。

典型错误.问题: 统计每位用户有多少个订单，没有订单的用户也要显示
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name ORDER BY order_count DESC, u.user_id;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.user_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id;

典型错误.问题: 统计各商品分类累计卖出的件数
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_quantity FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sold_quantity DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT p.category, COUNT(i.item_id) AS sold_count FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sold_count DESC;

典型错误.问题: 找出订单总金额超过 500 元的用户
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT u.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name HAVING total_spend > 500 ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.name FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.total_amount > 500;

典型错误.问题: 查询北京用户已经完成的订单编号和金额
典型错误.原始输出: {"sql":"SELECT o.order_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS total_amount FROM orders o INNER JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.city = '北京' AND o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY o.order_id;"}

典型错误.问题: 计算每个商品的库存金额并按金额降序排列
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT product_name, price * stock AS stock_value FROM products ORDER BY stock_value DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS inventory_value FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY inventory_value DESC;

典型错误.问题: 统计各商品分类累计卖出的件数
典型错误.原始输出: {"sql":"SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS sold_quantity FROM order_items GROUP BY category ORDER BY sold_quantity DESC;"}

典型错误.问题: 找出订单总金额超过 500 元的用户
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT u.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name HAVING total_spend > 500 ORDER BY total_spend DESC;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.total_amount > 500 ORDER BY u.register_date;

典型错误.问题: 统计每个城市的用户数量，按人数降序排列
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY user_count DESC, city;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.city, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY user_count DESC;

典型错误.问题: 找出包含至少两种不同商品的订单
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS product_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING product_count >= 2 ORDER BY product_count DESC, o.order_id;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, p1.product_name AS item1, p2.product_name AS item2, o.status FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi1 ON o.order_id = oi1.order_id JOIN order_items oi2 ON o.order_id = oi2.order_id JOIN products p1 ON oi1.product_id = p1.product_id JOIN products p2 ON oi2.product_id = p2.product_id WHERE p1.product_id != p2.product_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

典型错误.问题: 查询没有任何已完成订单的用户姓名
典型错误.期望SQL: SELECT u.name FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.status = '已完成' WHERE o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY u.user_id;
典型错误.预测SQL: SELECT u.name FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) = 0 ORDER BY u.register_date;
